items.title: Harry Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: I’ve transcribed several John Coltrane solos for an assignment at school.

ctx.x: No. I’ve never been a big solo transcriber. One, I’m blessed with perfect pitch, so transcribing a solo, I hear the notes as they go by anyway so transcribing is just a pain in the neck to sit down and write it. But I think I transcribed one of his solos for an
assignment at school, and I’ve transcribed several John Coltrane solos for an assignment at school. But that’s all the transcribing I’ve ever done.
What was your college experience like for jazz? Do you think it made a big difference for you?
